injuries.name: Taylor Hall
injuries.note: Hall was already expected to miss more time after the Hurricanes announced Tuesday that he had tweaked something different from his previous upper-body injury. While the exact nature of his new injury aren't yet clear, the 34-year-old is expected to be sidelined for multiple additional games following his setback.

injuries.name: Alexander Nikishin
injuries.note: After agreeing to a one-year, $3 million contract with the Hurricanes on Sunday, Nikishin hasn't joined the team yet. Head coach Rod Brind'Amour told reporters Monday that Nikishin will need a "mini training camp" to get up to speed. It's unclear when the 25-year-old Nikishin will be available to play. He registered 11 goals, 33 points, 33 PIM, 132 hits and 94 blocked shots in 81 regular-season appearances with Carolina in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Taylor Hall
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Hurricanes said on Thursday (Oct. 29) that Hall will miss more time, per Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal.

injuries.name: Alexander Nikishin
injuries.note: Not Injury Related: The Carolina Hurricanes said on Monday (Oct. 26) that Nikishin will need some time before he makes his 2026-27 debut, according to Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal.

injuries.name: Jordan Staal
injuries.note: Calf: The Carolina Hurricanes placed F Jordan Staal on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 15).

injuries.name: Isac Lundestrom
injuries.note: Achilles: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed F Isac Lundestrom on long-term injured reserve and was labeled month-to-month by general manager Rick Bowness, per Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers.

injuries.name: Ivan Provorov
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Columbus Blue Jackets said on Tuesday (Oct. 20) that Provorov is expected to remain sidelined on injured reserve on a week-to-week basis, per Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers.
